source_metadata.organization: India Meteorological Department (IMD), Ministry of Earth Sciences, Govt. of India
source_metadata.title: Standard Hydrometeorological Rainfall Classification and Color-Coded Warning System

Very_Light_Rain.description: Negligible runoff, normal urban drainage handles with zero accumulation.

Moderate_Rain.description: Moderate runoff, culverts and drains begin filling. Saturated soil risk in hilly tracts.

Heavy_Rain.description: High runoff, waterlogging in low-lying roads, rising levels in local tanks and nullahs.

Very_Heavy_Rain.description: Extensive inundation, culvert washouts, flash flooding in natural drainage corridors.

Extremely_Heavy_Rain.description: Catastrophic flooding, reservoir discharge spikes, embankment breaches, widespread structural inundation.

Yellow.label: Be Aware
Yellow.action: Watch condition. Severe weather expected that could disrupt low-lying transit corridors.

Orange.label: Be Prepared
Orange.action: Alert condition. High disruption risk; pre-position rescue teams, check OBMs and staging areas.

Red.label: Take Action
Red.action: Warning condition. Extreme weather imminent; initiate mandatory evacuations in vulnerable zones, full emergency deployment.

nowcast.purpose: Detect rapid convective storm cells and localized flash-flood cloudburst events.
